# tools: add git-lfs

Add [Git LFS](https://git-lfs.github.com) to the Homebrew toolset. **Motivation:** [tact-app/backup#3](https://github.com/tact-app/backup/issues/3) — a repository of the author's Tact project that stores large backup artefacts and needs LFS on every machine that clones it ([managing large files](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/working-with-files/managing-large-files)).

<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/428#issuecomment-5711705006
Code vs intent: the formula is installed but `git lfs install` (global filter/hook setup) is not run by `git_config` or `install`; a fresh machine has the binary and no LFS hooks until someone runs it by hand.
-->
